title: binary_smoke an_open_eventsource_stream_does_not_block_shutdown fails under full-suite load (connection refused)
description: Seen 2026-11-19 by the crate-jmap-bump agent: the mimid-server binary_smoke test failed once under full-suite load with connection refused, passed 3/3 alone. Likely a startup race (connecting before the binary listens). Fix: wait for the listening log line or retry the connect with a deadline.
close_reason: fixed in daf5bea on branch tests-notice-flaky: binary_smoke waits for the binary's own listening line (both listeners bound) plus one answer, restarts on a taken port; mtls_binaries same wait. Reproduced deterministically by holding startup between binds; 192/192 under load.
